== Trivia ==
* [[gww:Amber Chunk|Amber]] was a crafting material used in [[gww:Cantha|Cantha]].
* [[w:Amber|Amber]] is fossilized resin from trees, and as such can contain small creatures encased in the material, mostly insects. The term ''ambrite'' specifically refers to amber found in coal seams in New Zealand.
